title: We will worship the maker

lines.text: We will worship the maker of all things,
Almighty God, to you our voices sing,
You are the Holy One, Father, Spirit, Son,
King of kings and Lord of lords,

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We will worship the maker of all things,
Almighty God, to you our voices sing,
Hallowed be thy name (2)
You are the Holy One, Father, Spirit, Son,
King of kings and Lord of lords,
Hallowed be, Hallowed be
